subject: english
title: Unit 7 Song
subtitle: Inventions — listen, sing, and use the song lines to recycle the Vocabulary 1 words and preview used to for past habits.

content: Identify chorus and verse in the song "Inventions".
Name the inventions mentioned in the song and say which ones help people get from place to place.
Give an opinion about the most important invention and support it with a reason.
language: Sing and read the song with the Unit 7 Vocabulary 1 words in context: creativity, electricity, an invention, a problem, a wheel, useful, imagination, an idea.
Rephrase past-habit sentences with used to + verb (Grammar 1, from verse 3).
Notice the generalized you as opposed to you the listener (Grammar 2).
